tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen du bsgrub pa'i cho ga 'phrin las mkha' khyab bzhugs so// ༄༅/ /na mo gu ru bud+dha dha dza ye/ /bla ma dang thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sbyor ba ston pa'i sku bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar mchod pa legs par bsham/ bsgrub bya khyim pa'i cha lugs can gyis/ thog mar ston pa la yan lag lnga pa gtugs pa'i phyag gsum 'tshal du bcug de nas rang la gsum 'tshal du bcug nas mdun du tsog tsog pur 'dug tu bcug cing thal mo snying khar sbyor du bcug nas/ 'di skad ces brjod de/ 'dir bstan pa'i rtsa ba so so thar pa'i sdom pa yin la/ de la bshad tshul mang du yod pa las/ 'dir dam pa'i chos 'dul ba nas gsungs pa'i so thar gyi sdom pa 'bog par byed pa la/ 'dul ba mdo rtsa ba las/ dge bsnyen nyid dang dge tshul nyid dge slong nyid dag gis snga ma bsnyen par ma rdzogs pa la phyi ma mi bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pas bstan pa la rim gyis slob par byed pa la dge slong gi sdom pa len pa'i sngon du/ dge tshul gyi sdom pa dang / de'i sngon du dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa len par byed dgos/ 'di la nyes med phun tshogs zhes kyang bya ste/ de ltar sdom pa gsum rim gyis byin pas mkhan slob la nyes pa mi 'byung zhing / bsgrub bya'i rgyud la sdom pa phun sum tshogs pa skye bar 'gyur bas na de skad ces bya'o/ /skye la nyes byas kyi dbang du byas na/ bslab pa'i tshigs gsum po snga ma snga ma sngon du ma song bar/ phyi ma phyi ma sbyin du mi rung ste/ de ltar du 'dul ba lung las rgyas par gsungs shing / mdo rtsa ba las kyang tshigs snga ma sngon du ma song ba la nyes byas so/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /'dir nyes med phun tshogs kyi dbang du byas nas thog mar dge bsnyen du sgrub par byed pa yin la/ de yang dge bsnyen gyi don ni/ u pa si ka zhes pa dge bsnyen gyi skad dod yin la/

de yang don dam pa'i dge ba mya ngan las 'das pa la nye ba'i don gyis na dge bsnyen zhes bya ba yin/ spyir dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa la gsung rab las bshad tshul gyi dbang du byas na/ skyabs gsum 'dzin pa'i dge bsnyen/ sna gcig spyod pa/ sna 'ga' spyod pa/ phal cher spyod pa/ yongs su spyod pa/ tshangs par spyod pa/ go ma'i dge bsnyen rnams su yod pa las/ 'dir yongs su rdzogs pa'i dge bsnyen du sgrub par byed pa yin/ yongs su rdzogs pa'i dge bsnyen la yang kun slong bsam pa'i bye brag gis/ 'jigs skyob kyi/ legs smon gyi/ nges 'byung gi yongs su rdzogs pa'i dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa rnams su yod pa las/ 'jigs skyob ni/ tshe 'dir rgyal po'i chad pa dang / nad gdon sogs kyi 'jigs pa las skyob par 'dod pa tsam gyi bsam pas kun nas blangs pa yin zhing / legs smon ni/ phyi mar lha dang mi'i bde 'bras tsam thob pa 'dod pa'i bsam pas kun nas blangs pa'i sdom pa yin la/ de tsam ni phyi rol mu stegs byed la'ang yod cing / sdom pa de dag la nges 'byung gi bsam pa med pas so so thar pa'i sdom pa dang thar pa'i lam du mi 'gyur te/ mdzod 'grel las/ ci phyi rol pa rnams la yang dag par blangs pa las byung pa'i tshul khrims med dam zhe na/ yod mod kyi/ so so thar pa'i sdom pa ni min te/ de ni srid pa la brten pa'i phyir/ rten sdig pa las thar bar byed pa ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /des na so so thar pa'i sdom pa dang / thar pa'i lam du 'gyur ba la nges 'byung gi bsam pas zin pa nges par dgos te/ mdo rtsa ba las/ nges par 'byung ba'i tshul khrims kyi dbang du byas te/ zhes pa dang / 'dul ba sum brgya pa las/ nges par 'byung ba'i tshul khrims sdug bsngal spongs/ zhes sdug bsngal de las thar pa'i mya ngan las 'das thob 'dod kyi bsam pa bcos min zhig la 'jog pa yin te/ rje btsun rin po ches/

mya ngan 'das pa sgrub pa la/ khams gsum la zhen pa spang yang 'tshal/ /khams gsum la zhen pa spong ba la/ /'khor ba'i nyes dmigs dran yang 'tshal/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /'khor ba'i nyes dmigs dran pa la/ 'khor ba la sdug bsngal dang skyon gyi rnam pa ji lta bu yod snyam na khams gsum dang / rig drug gis bsdus pa'i 'khor ba thams cad sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin can yin te bcom ldan 'das kyi mdo las/ 'dod pa'i khams ni skyon dang bcas pa ste/ /gzugs kyi khams kyang skyon dang bcas pa yin/ /de bzhin gzugs med khams kyang skyon dang bcas/ /mya ngan 'das pa 'ba' zhig skyon med mthong / /zhes pa dang / mdo dran pa nyer gzhag las/ sems can dmyal ba dmyal mes nyams/ /yi dwags bkres shing skom pas nyams/ /dud 'gro gcig la gcig zas nyams/ /mi dag 'tsho ba thung bas nyams/ /lha dag bag med pa yis nyams/ /'khor ba khab kyi rtse tsam na/ /bde ba nam yang yod ma yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar sems can dmyal ba pa rnams la grang ba dang tsha ba'i sdug bsngal bzod glags med pas nyam thag pa dang / yi dwags rnams la bkres pa dang skom pa'i sdug bsngal bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / dud 'gro rnams la gcig la gcig bza' ba dang glen zhing gti mug la sogs pa brjod kyis mi lang ba'i sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal mtha' yas pas nyams pa dang / mtho ris gsum la'ang lha ma yin rnams lha'i dpal 'byor la rang bzhin gyis phrag dog pas 'thab rtsod kyi sdug bsngal dang / 'dod pa'i lha rnams kyang de nas shi 'phos te dmyal bar skye ba rang gis shes pa na/ dmyal ba pa'i lus kyi sdug bsngal las sems kyi sdug bsngal che ba yod pa dang / gzugs med kyi lha rnams la da lta sdug bsngal mngon gyur pa tsam med kyang / bya nam mkha' la 'phur ba nam zhig sa la lhung ba ltar las kyi dbang gis khams gong nas shi 'phos te/ dmyal ba la sogs par skyes nas sdug bsngal tshabs chen po myong ba yod pa dang /

mi rnams la'ang chen po rnams la sems kyi sdug bsngal/ dman pa rnams la lus kyi sdug bsngal/ nor yod pa la bsrung bsog gi sdug bsngal/ med pa la 'tshol 'gro'i sdug bsngal/ 'dod pa thog tu mi babs/ mi 'dod pa thog tu 'bab pa dang / mi sems rags pa bsrung dka' ba dang / dgra dang 'phrad pa dang / gnyen dang bral ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal dang / mdor na dang por skye ba dang / bar du na ba dang / rgas pa dang / mthar 'chi ba'i rang bzhin las ma 'das pa 'dug pas na 'khor ba 'di gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal gyi gnas/ su dang 'grogs kyang sdug bsngal bskyed pa'i grogs/ gang la longs spyod kyang sdug bsngal spyod pa'i longs spyod/ sdug bsngal gyi mtshan nyid can gyi 'khor ba 'di las thar pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa ci nas kyang thob par bya/ de'i ched du yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa blang snyam pa'i sems bskyed par mdzod/ bsam pa de tsam nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams la yang yod pas nges 'byung gi bsam pas go chod mod/ 'dir theg pa chen po'i sdom pa len par byed pa la bsam pa 'di bzhin du bskyed par mdzod/ de yang chos rje sa skya paṇ+ṭi tas/ des na da lta'i cho ga ni/ /bsam pa sems skyed kyis zin pa'i/ /cho ga nyan thos lugs bzhin gyis/ /so so thar pa rigs brgyad po/ /byang sems so so thar par 'gyur/ /zhes gzhan du sangs rgyas thob 'dod kyi bsam pas zin pa'i sdom pa thams cad theg pa chen po'i so thar gyi sdom pa dang / byang sems kyis sdom par 'gyur/ zhes gsungs pas na/ sems can gyi don du sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa'i bsam pa skyed pa gal che ba yin te/ mdo las/ nam mkha'i mtha' gtugs gyur pa ji tsam par/ /sems can ma lus mtha' yang de bzhin te/ /ji tsam las dang nyon mong mthar gyur pa/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar nam mkha' la mtha' med pa bzhin du sems can la mtha' med/ mtha' med pa'i sems can thams cad rang dang 'brel med ma yin te/

skye shi 'phos nas ngo ma shes pa ma gtogs pha ma ma byas pa med cing byas res kyis gnod pa las skyabs shing phan btags pa'i drin can sha stag yin pas/ de rnams bor nas bdag nyid bde bar 'dod pa mi rigs te/ ji skad du/ skye shi 'phos pa'i ngo ma shes pa de bor nas/ /gal te cig thar byed na de las khrel bor med/ /ces gsungs pas so/ /pha ma sems can rnams bde ba 'dod cing sdug bsngal mi 'dod kyang / rgyu 'bras log par spyad pas kha cig ni da lta tsha grang la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal tshabs chen po la longs spyod cing / kha cig ni sdug bsngal gyi rgyu mi dge ba rngam po che la spyod par byed pa 'di rnams snying re rje/ snying re rje snyam du bzhag pas mi phan/ 'di rnams sdug bsngal las bsgral te bde ba la 'god par byed dgos la/ de'i nus pa da lta rang re rnams la ji lta ba bzhin du med cing / rang las che ba tshangs pa dang / brgya byin dang / nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams la'ang med/ su la yod na rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid la yod pa yin te/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos tshigs su bcad pa gcig tsam gsungs pa dang / sku las 'od zer cung zad spros pa la sogs mdzad pa du ma'i sgo nas sems can dpag tu med pa'i don mdzad par nus pas na/ bdag gis pha ma sems can thams cad kyi don du mi gnas pa'i myang 'das rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang ci nas kyang thob par bya/ de'i ched du yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa blang snyam pa'i sems bskyed par mdzod/ yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro tsam byed du byas nas len dgos te/ mdo rtsa ba las/ skyabs su 'gro bar khas blangs pa'i tshig rtsom pa dang / zhes gsungs pas so/ /de yang sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi bas mya ngan las 'das pa'i lam ston pa po zhu zhing / chos la skyabs su mchi bas mya ngan las 'das pa la skyabs dngos su zhu/

dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi bas myang 'das sgrub pa'i zla grogs la skyabs zhus nas sdom pa len par byed pa yin no/ /de thams cad kyi don hril dril na/ sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin can gyi 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i pha ma sems can thams cad kyi don du/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song nas/ dus 'di nas bzung ste ma shi'i bar du yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa blangs la bsrung / bdag bslab gzhi lnga 'dzin pa'i dge bsnyen du gzung du gsol snyam pa gyis la cho ga 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ btsun pa dgongs su gsol/ bdag bsgrub bya rang gi ming gang yin pa nas brjod/ ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid 'tsho'i bar du rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'dod chags dang bral ba rnams kyi mchog chos la skyabs su mchi'o/ /tshogs rnams kyi mchog dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ /bdag ji srid 'tsho'i bar du dge bsnyen du btsun pas gzung du gsol/ lhag bor ma gtogs pa'i rang gi don gyi sngags brjod pa yang ngo / zhes lan gsum bzla dgos par gsungs pas/ gnyis pa'i yang rjes zlos mdzod/ ces brjod nas/ sngar bzhin btsun pa dgongs su gsol/ zhes pa nas/ gzung du gsol gyi bar brjod/ gnyis pa song ba'i rjes su cho ga 'di la dum bu gsum/ dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o yan chad skyabs brjod pa/ bdag ji srid 'tsho'i bar du zhes pa bdag brjod pa/ btsun pas gzung du gsol zhes pa gzhan brjod pa yin pas/ bdag brjod rdzogs pa dge bsnyen du zhes pa'i tshig rdzogs pa dang / khyed kyi rgyud la khyed kyi sdom pa thob par nges pa'i ched du nged kyis kyang dge bsnyen du zhes pa'i skad gzengs mtho ba mdzad pa'ang 'dug dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa skye/ nged khyed kyi slob dpon du 'gyur ba yin pas/ de dus sdom pa thob par shes pa dang /

slob dpon du gyur nas slob dpon gyis gzung du gsol zhes brjod dgos pas de yid la zhog la gsum pa'i rjes zlos kyis ces brjod/ gsum pa zin pa dang / slob dpon gyis thabs yin no zhes brjod/ slob mas legs so zhes brjod/ des khyed kyis dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa thob pa yin/ des dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa 'bog pa'i dngos gzhi'i cho ga song nas/ mjug bslab bya brjod pa la bsam pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ sdom pa thob kyang ma bsrung na phan yon chen po mi 'byung zhing / nyes dmigs chen po 'byung bas bsrung dgos/ bsrung lugs sngon dgra bcom pa rnams kyis srog gcod pa sogs lnga yid kyis spangs te/ lus ngag gi slar log pa de bzhin du bdag gis kyang bslab snyam pa gyis la 'dis rjes zlos mdzod/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ ji ltar 'phags pa dgra bcom pa de dag gis/ ji srid 'tsho'i bar du srog gcod pa spangs te/ srog gcod pa las slar log pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid 'tsho'i bar du srog gcod pa spangs te/ srog gcod pa las slar log par bgyi'o/ /yan lag dang po 'dis bdag 'phags pa dgra bcom pa de dag gi bslab pa la rjes su slob bo/ rjes su bsgrub bo/ /rjes su bgyid do/ /gzhan yang ji ltar 'phags pa dgra bcom pa de dag gis/ ji srid 'tsho'i bar du ma byin par len pa dang / 'dod pas log par g.yem pa dang / rdzun du smra ba dang / 'bru'i chang dang / bcos pa'i chang myos bar 'gyur ba bag med pa'i gnas spangs te/ 'bru'i chang dang / bcos pa'i chang / myos par 'gyur ba bag med pa'i gnas las slar log pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid 'tsho'i bar du ma byin par len pa dang / 'dod pas log par g.yem pa dang / rdzun du smra ba dang / 'bru'i chang dang / bcos pa'i chang myos par 'gyur ba bag med pa'i gnas spangs te/

'bru'i chang dang / bcos pa'i chang dang / myos par 'gyur ba bag med pa'i gnas las slar log par bgyi'o/ /yan lag lnga pa 'dis bdag 'phags pa dgra bcom pa de dag gi bslab pa la rjes su slob bo/ /rjes su bsgrub bo/ /rjes su bgyid do/ /slob dpon gyis thabs yin no/ /zhes brjod/ dge bsnyen gyis legs so zhes brjod do/ /bslab pa brjod pa 'di rgya dper lan gsum bzlas par gsungs kyang / lung dang / karma sha taṃ dang / de dag gi 'grel pa las lan gsum bzlas bya ba'i dmigs bsal ma byung bas lan gsum dang lan gcig gang rung brjod/ des khyed kyis dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa legs par thob nas/ dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa'i skyabs 'gro'i bslab bya sangs rgyas la skyabs su song bas 'jig rten pa'i lha la phyag mi bya/ chos la skyabs su song bas/ sems can la gnod 'tshe spongs/ dge 'dun la skyabs su song bas grogs mu stegs can dang mi 'grogs pa dang / skyabs 'gro'i bslab bya thun mong du skyes bu dam pa la bsten pa dang / dam pa'i chos nyan pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la bya ba dang / chos kyi rjes su 'brangs pa'i chos bsgrub pa ste bzhi dang / dbang po mi rgod pa dang / sdom pa ci nus su len pa dang / sems can la snying brtse ba dang / dkon mchog mchod pa la brtson pa rnams la tshul bzhin du bslab/ dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa'i yan lag mi gsod pa la sogs pa bzhi yan lag tshang ba'i sgo nas byung na sdom pa gtong bas bskyar nas len/ mi ma yin gsod pa sogs lnga byung na/ sdom ldan gcig la bshags pa bya/ phra ma sogs mi dge ba gzhan drug po phyogs mthun yin pas yid kyis bsdams nas legs par srungs shig ces brjod/ yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa 'bog pa'i cho ga'o/ /'di dag gis karma sha taṃ las/ dge bsnyen slob pa dang zhes pa'i don bshad pa yin no/ /zhes yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen du sgrub pa'i cho ga 'phrin las mkha' khyab ces bya ba 'di yang rigs ldan 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mched dang /

rgyal ba mus pa chen po bud+dha'i mtshan can rnams gtso bor smos pa'i yongs 'dzin chos bzhin du spyod pa du ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa shrī sa skya pa shākya'i dge slong byams pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ gling kha bde ba can gyi yang dben bsam gtan phug tu bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi sdom pa thob pa'i tshe/ yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa logs su 'bog tshul 'di lta bu'i yig cha zhig bgyi 'dod yod pa bzhin/ dus phyis dpal ldan sa skya'i chos grwa chen por sbyar ba'o/ /'di'i 'phrin las nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur cig/ //sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen du sgrub pa'i cho ga 'phrin las mkha' khyab/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
